acceptance.pointer_gate: event first; read back exact event; second CURRENT must remain exact v57 and exact blob d58d3340a5a589accc282d7d53fea6d479c2917b before single-file update; final readback must be v58
acceptance.replay_rule: same domain-separated semantic-intent key is DUPLICATE and does not write or advance; a semantic intent bound to different expected/prior/next versions or prior digest derives a different key

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: Chain-scoping depends on correct version and prior-digest inputs. It prevents cross-version key collapse in this local specimen, but can split semantically equivalent retries after compensation or migration, and GitHub search remains stale and nonatomic. Event creation, CURRENT replacement, reads, and Slack are separate effects; no uniqueness constraint, cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, or exactly-once guarantee.

probe.name: SEMANTIC_INTENT_KEY_CHAIN_SCOPED_BY_VERSION_AND_PRIOR_DIGEST_V3
probe.result: Two local synthetic semantic intents held object, task, campaign, factor, controlled probe, and wake ordinal constant while changing only chain coordinates. Their semantic-intent digests and idempotency keys differed, so this implementation did not collapse the command across versions.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the immutable event; append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version and replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
